nom: RoC Multi Correxion Hydrate + Plump Hyaluronic Acid Eye Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some who describe their eye area as chronically dry and flaky under concealer, report the cream finally leaves the area hydrated and smoother.
segments.sensitive: A large number of self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including several who react badly to fragranced eye creams, report no burning, irritation, or itching with this cream; one reviewer, who does not describe her skin as sensitive, instead developed three styes within five days of use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s to 70s who describe their skin as aging report visibly smoother, brighter under-eyes with reduced puffiness and fine lines, with several specifically saying it makes them look less tired without concealer.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers report visibly smoother fine lines, softened crow's feet, and reduced puffiness or bags within one to three weeks, often looking less tired without concealer; several reviewers report no improvement or even worsening, including one whose fine lines became deep wrinkles and two others who saw no change in crow's feet or puffiness after weeks or months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with chronically dry under-eye skin, report the cream leaves the area visibly hydrated and plumper, often within days; one reviewer says she could not tell any difference and found it not very hydrating compared to CeraVe.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers who mention dark circles report visible fading or reduced darkness with continued use; two reviewers say it made no difference to their dark circles.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers say it does not cause breakouts, milia, or irritation around the eyes; two reviewers report the opposite, one who developed new pimples under the eye and another who developed three styes within five days.

aspects.libelle: Tube packaging leaks or oozes product
Absorbs quickly, wears well under makeup
Brief tingling or warming on application

extraits.titre: Not for me. Made my eyes look worse
extraits.texte: With great reviews, I decided to try this. Not only did it not work, it actually made my troubled spots worse. The fine lines under my eyes became deep wrinkles. I do not recommend.

I've been using this cream about 5 days and it that time, I've developed 3 styes. I never get those! I had a very slight warming sensation when I put it on, but it was short, so I ignored it. I shouldn't have! I don't even put it all the way up to my lash line, just on the hollows area, outer corner away from my eye, and on my brow bone. I will say that it is very smooth (Dimethicone), lightweight, and my concealer went on smoothly.

extraits.titre: Would buy this again and highly recommend it!
extraits.texte: Use it a.m. and p,m. Stays moist and in place. Reduces undereye bags but I don't have any wrinkles so I don't know about that. Am 73 with terrific skin. Love this product.

I am almost 35 and have very dry skin. I have used a plethora of eye creams over the years, and none of them have given me the results that this one has in just a few short weeks. My under eyes are FINALLY hydrated looking, my fine lines are not nearly as noticeable and my concealer goes on so smoothly now. I absolutely love this, and a little goes a long way. My only negative is the packaging… when I open it, I don't even have to squeeze before the eye cream starts squirting out so a lot of it get stuck in the lid. But for overall results, this stuff rocks!

extraits.titre: Great for sensitive eyes and skin
extraits.texte: My skin is so sensitive and a lot of eye creams irritate my skin or they dont work at all. This is amazing for adding hydration to my eye area and i can use it even when my eyes are acting up and are so sensitive. Works well under makeup, but also at night. Love that it comes in a tube. I wish more eye creams did bc its more sanitary

Let me start by saying I have extremely sensitive skin and hesitated to try something new, especially around my eyes but SURPRISE!! No burning, no irritation, no itching AND it works! The dark circles under my eyes are fading, puffiness is gone, and the scent isn't offensive at all. After trying one product after another, wasting I don't know how much money I finally found one that works so ladies stop wasting your money on items with big promises and zero results and buy Roc!!

extraits.titre: Noticeable results after 1 week of use.
extraits.texte: The Roc Multi Correxion Hydrate & Plump eye cream worked well from the first use. I have been using it in the morning and evening. I have older skin, and wrinkles, laugh lines. I notice a big difference already in the deepness. The areas around my mouth and eyes stay hydrated all day. I will continue to use this product, a little goes a long way. The Hydrate & Plump eye cream does not leave any sticky residue and had just a light fragrance.
